name: Evelyn Moinard
original_name: エヴリン・モワナール
source:
She is the queen of Fulstadja, a small High Elven kingdom that occupies a forested area.

Although she is called the “Jewel of Fulstadja” for her beauty, she is still young for a High Elf at 150 years of age, and her appearance is still very childlike.

On the other hand, she excels in magic and has no equal in the country. However, perhaps because of her beauty, magical power, and position, she is selfish and arrogant, and throws tantrums when she does not get her way.

Even so, she takes pride in being the queen loved by the people.

[From [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq40/spin.html]official site[/url]]
